name: Invoice
description: A printable invoice generated from a SubscriptionInstance. Snapshots customer info, billing-cycle context, and per-line-item charges at generation time. Stripe integration hooks via stripeInvoiceId.

global.schema:
type InvoiceState {
    invoiceNumber: String
    issuedAt: DateTime
    dueDate: DateTime
    status: InvoiceStatus!
    customerId: PHID
    customerName: String
    customerEmail: EmailAddress
    sourceSubscriptionId: PHID
    sourceSubscriptionName: String
    cycleStart: DateTime
    cycleEnd: DateTime
    billingCycle: InvoiceBillingCycle
    lineItems: [InvoiceLineItem!]!
    currency: Currency
    subtotal: Amount_Money!
    creditApplied: Amount_Money!
    totalDue: Amount_Money!
    totalPaid: Amount_Money!
    stripeInvoiceId: String
    notes: String
}

enum InvoiceStatus {
    DRAFT
    ISSUED
    PAID
    VOID
}

enum InvoiceBillingCycle {
    MONTHLY
    QUARTERLY
    SEMI_ANNUAL
    ANNUAL
    ONE_TIME
}

enum InvoiceLineItemOrigin {
    SETUP
    SUBSCRIPTION_FEE
    DYNAMIC
    ESTIMATED_USAGE
    RECONCILIATION
}

type InvoiceLineItem {
    id: OID!
    sliceId: OID!
    origin: InvoiceLineItemOrigin!
    description: String!
    sourceName: String
    chargedAt: DateTime!
    debitAmount: Amount_Money!
    settledAmount: Amount_Money!
    creditApplied: Amount_Money!
    amountDue: Amount_Money!
    currency: Currency!
}
global.initialValue:
{
  "invoiceNumber": null,
  "issuedAt": null,
  "dueDate": null,
  "status": "DRAFT",
  "customerId": null,
  "customerName": null,
  "customerEmail": null,
  "sourceSubscriptionId": null,
  "sourceSubscriptionName": null,
  "cycleStart": null,
  "cycleEnd": null,
  "billingCycle": null,
  "lineItems": [],
  "currency": null,
  "subtotal": 0,
  "creditApplied": 0,
  "totalDue": 0,
  "totalPaid": 0,
  "stripeInvoiceId": null,
  "notes": null
}

modules.name: invoice
modules.description: Invoice lifecycle: initialization, status transitions, Stripe link, notes.

operations.name: INITIALIZE_INVOICE
operations.description: Populate the invoice with a snapshot from a SubscriptionInstance. Single-shot — overwrites any prior values. Use right after document creation.
operations.schema:
input InvoiceLineItemInput {
    id: OID!
    sliceId: OID!
    origin: InvoiceLineItemOrigin!
    description: String!
    sourceName: String
    chargedAt: DateTime!
    debitAmount: Amount_Money!
    settledAmount: Amount_Money!
    creditApplied: Amount_Money!
    amountDue: Amount_Money!
    currency: Currency!
}

input InitializeInvoiceInput {
    invoiceNumber: String
    dueDate: DateTime
    customerId: PHID
    customerName: String
    customerEmail: EmailAddress
    sourceSubscriptionId: PHID
    sourceSubscriptionName: String
    cycleStart: DateTime
    cycleEnd: DateTime
    billingCycle: InvoiceBillingCycle
    lineItems: [InvoiceLineItemInput!]!
    currency: Currency
    subtotal: Amount_Money!
    creditApplied: Amount_Money!
    totalDue: Amount_Money!
    totalPaid: Amount_Money!
    notes: String
}
operations.template: Populate the invoice with a snapshot from a SubscriptionInstance. Single-shot — overwrites any prior values. Use right after document creation.

operations.name: MARK_INVOICE_ISSUED
operations.description: Transition invoice from DRAFT to ISSUED. Stamps issuedAt.
operations.template: Transition invoice from DRAFT to ISSUED. Stamps issuedAt.

errors.name: InvoiceNotDraftError
errors.description: Invoice can only be issued from DRAFT status

operations.name: MARK_INVOICE_PAID
operations.description: Transition invoice from ISSUED or PARTIALLY_PAID to PAID. Sets totalPaid to totalDue.
operations.template: Transition invoice from ISSUED or PARTIALLY_PAID to PAID. Sets totalPaid to totalDue.

errors.name: InvoiceNotIssuedError
errors.description: Invoice can only be marked paid from ISSUED status

errors.name: InvoicePaidInvalidAmountError
errors.description: Paid amount must be greater than zero

operations.name: VOID_INVOICE
operations.description: Mark the invoice as VOID. Reason recorded in notes.
operations.template: Mark the invoice as VOID. Reason recorded in notes.

operations.name: SET_STRIPE_INVOICE_ID
operations.description: Link the Powerhouse invoice document to a Stripe invoice ID. Set by the Stripe integration when an invoice is pushed/charged.
operations.template: Link the Powerhouse invoice document to a Stripe invoice ID. Set by the Stripe integration when an invoice is pushed/charged.

operations.name: SET_INVOICE_NOTES
operations.description: Operator note attached to the invoice (terms, payment instructions, void reason).
operations.template: Operator note attached to the invoice (terms, payment instructions, void reason).
